assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

A provider refuses a turn because the quota is used up. On 2.x the refusal is terminal and classified: probed with the repo's mock-openai-429 (HTTP 403 `insufficient_quota`, which the AI SDK does not retry — /Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b2-work/probe/2-9-mock.log), the turn ended at once with an `idle` row, outcome `failed`, error `{type: provider.quota, status: 403, message: "You exceeded your current quota…"}`. parser_v2.go turns a failed idle into SessionError (v2SessionError: class = the error's type), the plugin forwards `session.execution.failed` (a Stop hook), and the classifier routes a turn that ended in failure to the error state.

## Recipe

The mock answers its FIRST request and refuses every later one. 2.x sends the session-title request concurrently with the first turn's request (4 ms apart, measured), so the success would go to whichever lands first. To make the order deterministic, turn 1 runs on the sandbox's own Kolibri model (the title is generated there), the `model` step then moves the session to the mock provider, turn 2 takes the mock's one success, and turn 3 hits the exhausted quota.

## Wire check

The per-cell config, with every provider's baseURL pointed at a local capture stub (/Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b2-work/probe/wire-2-9b.log): the title and turn 1 named the Kolibri path (the sandbox's kolibri provider), turns 2 and 3 named `mock-quota-model`. No request names any other model.
caveats: The failed turn's arc is measured, not assumed: the Stop hook may land before the store's failed idle row (P5a measured the idle row 60-460 ms after the hook), so a brief ready before error is possible; the spec pins only that the turn ends in error and stays there.

sources.note: each assistant row's model.id is the step's ModelName; text items feed applyAssistantText (task-estimate scan)
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
a turn that ended with a SessionError → error ("turn ended in failure → error")
probe: 403 insufficient_quota → idle failed, error.type provider.quota, no retry
wire check: every request named the Kolibri path or mock-quota-model

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset

The repo's mock-openai-429 running at 127.0.0.1:18766 for the whole run (default flags: the first request succeeds, every later one is HTTP 403 insufficient_quota); it serves the mock provider's turns, so they never reach the local model. Build: go build -o .build/refresh/bin/mock-openai-429 ./tools/onboarding-factory/recording/mock-openai-429/
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
mock provider `mockquota` declared in RUN_CWD/opencode.json (baseURL 127.0.0.1:18766); the session starts on the sandbox's default Kolibri model; the shell is denied
turn 1 on Kolibri, then the model step to mockquota/mock-quota-model, turn 2 (the mock's one success), turn 3 (403 insufficient_quota)

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: ok. Do not use any tools.
Reply with exactly the word: two
Reply with exactly the word: three

verify: turn 3's quota refusal ends the turn in error, and the session stays in error (no ready, no waiting)
the transcript's last idle row is outcome failed, error.type provider.quota
